stem.text: Which enthalpy change is indicated by X in the enthalpy cycle shown?

stem.alt: Enthalpy cycle: C(s) + 2H2(g) + 2O2(g) at top; CH4(g) + 2O2(g) and CO2(g) + 2H2O(l) below; arrows labelled ΔH_f CH4(g), ΔH_c CH4(g) and ΔH_f CO2(g) + X

A.text: $-4 \times$ the enthalpy of combustion of hydrogen

B.text: $+4 \times$ the enthalpy of combustion of hydrogen

C.text: $-2 \times$ the enthalpy of formation of water

D.text: $+2 \times$ the enthalpy of formation of water
